# awscc_licensemanagerusersubscriptions_license_server_endpoint (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::LicenseManagerUserSubscriptions::LicenseServerEndpoint. A license server endpoint that provides access to Remote Desktop Services Subscriber Access License servers for a registered identity provider.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity_provider_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that identifies the registered identity provider the license server endpoint is created for. For Active Directory, that can be a self-managed Active Directory or an AWS Managed Microsoft AD.

### Optional

- `license_server_settings` (Attributes) The settings of the RDS license server to create the endpoint for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--license_server_settings))
- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags that apply for the license server endpoint. A maximum of 50 tags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `creation_time` (String) The timestamp when License Manager created the license server endpoint.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `license_server_endpoint_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the license server endpoint.
- `license_server_endpoint_id` (String) The ID of the license server endpoint.
- `license_server_endpoint_provisioning_status` (String) The current state of the provisioning process for the license server endpoint.
- `license_servers` (Attributes List) The license servers that are accessed through this endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--license_servers))
- `server_endpoint` (Attributes) The network address of a license server endpoint. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_endpoint))
- `server_type` (String) The type of license server.

<a id="nestedatt--license_server_settings"></a>

Optional:

- `server_type` (String) The type of license server.

Optional:

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_licensemanagerusersubscriptions_license_server_endpoint.example
  identity = {
    identity_provider_arn       = "identity_provider_arn"
    license_server_endpoint_arn = "license_server_endpoint_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `identity_provider_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that identifies the registered identity provider the license server endpoint is created for
- `license_server_endpoint_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the license server endpoint

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_licensemanagerusersubscriptions_license_server_endpoint.example
  id = "identity_provider_arn|license_server_endpoint_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_licensemanagerusersubscriptions_license_server_endpoint.example "identity_provider_arn|license_server_endpoint_arn"
```
